correctness.rationale: For a fixed source on a tree, only vertices of each removed target subtree can be saved; every vertex reach probability is an exact power of p. Root-neighbor candidates dominate descendants, profiles are exactly positive compositions, and two optimality losses require two zeros in a fixed pairwise difference. The exact rational Sturm verifier checked all 6144 profile pairs with sum <=12, 150 eligible differences and zero with >=2 roots. The 14-vertex profiles (1,1,4),(1,2,1,1,1,1) have gap p²(-1+3p-p²-p³-p⁴), with two and only two simple interior roots by signs/Descartes. Independent 8192-bond enumeration reproduced 3 parameter cases. No continuous theorem relies on finite numerical sampling.

value.rationale: This is the first attainable population size for a natural, parameter-dependent reversal of a single optimal vaccine placement in the fixed-source Reed–Frost tree model. Sharp lower bound plus attaining two-switch witness separate finite combinatorial constraints from heuristic priority rankings. The exact invariant is scientifically motivated by finite-dose intervention under uncertain transmissibility and is not just an arbitrary coefficient-table computation.
